facts.text: I joined the army for lunch. Somebody said there'd be dessert.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. John's real lines are about drill and basic training. Dewey 'Ox' Oxberger, the big recruit, has the food line: 'he told me I swallow a lot of aggression... along with a lot of pizzas!'.
facts.fix: He told me I swallow a lot of aggression... along with a lot of pizzas!

facts.why: The script has the captain welcoming Colonel Glass to Fort Arnold, so the base name is in the film.

vibe.verdict: The Fort Arnold mess hall hits Francis, the fact Jack and the EM-50, but the rest is ordinary army canteen food.
ideas: Swap 'Boot camp crackers with pimento cheese' for 'Mud wrestling pizza' for Ox.

Add a 'Winnebago' RV-shaped sandwich for the EM-50.
